claycode.delta: Do not make Unicode NFC/NFKC an implicit schema-blind canonicalizer step for generic String. Preserve exact Unicode scalar sequence by default; make any normalized-text semantics explicit/type-directed and domain-separate its semantic hash. Reject non-scalar/lone-surrogate values at the canonical semantic boundary. Add concat/interpolation normalization conformance cases if explicit NFC text is introduced.

frank.delta: Replay/version/provenance-bearing FRANK state must not rely on accidental host Unicode normalization. Exact source/provenance identity remains distinct from any explicit normalized human-text identity.

harness.delta: Future H1/H2 differential traces should include Unicode exact-vs-canonical-equivalent strings, compatibility-only strings, invalid scalar cases and normalization-after-concat cases so Reference and ClayCode Harnesses cannot silently diverge in text identity.

claygraph.delta: Graph node/relation identity must declare whether a human-text label is exact, normalized display/search text, or merely metadata. Compatibility normalization must not silently merge graph identities or provenance.

unifieddb.delta: Query/key/dedup semantics need an explicit Unicode collation/normalization contract per data class. Storage/database collation must not silently define Clay semantic identity.

gwt.delta: Unicode canonical identity does not alter current workspace competition/re-entry hypotheses. Text identity remains representation infrastructure, not evidence of GWT causal closure.

emergenz.delta: No emergence claim changes. Semantic hash equality or Unicode equivalence is not causal-emergence evidence.

hyperposition.delta: No topology/coupling claim changes. The existing typed-identity requirement remains sufficient.

clayresearch.delta: Integrated Clay research should carry this as a compiler/runtime identity constraint: Unicode normalization is an explicit semantic choice, not an invisible substrate behavior.
